name: Vethrin
text: Routed pipe. Joins every pipe next to it into one network. Items inside travel one block per second along the shortest route to the best sink. Age V.

name: Dolvareth
text: Sink pipe. Delivers items into the inventories touching it. Use an item on it to list that item, a stick to raise its priority (sneak to lower), sneak with an empty hand to take everything. Higher priority is served first, then the nearer pipe. Age V.

name: Quelmurak
text: Extractor pipe. Every second pulls items from the inventories touching it and sends them to a sink pipe that wants them and has room. Age V.

name: Ashkirel
text: Speed pipe. Items pass through four times faster than through a plain pipe. Age V.
